(2) Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 28 Disember 2012.

Pertama, bagi tempoh yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3) Jadual Pertama dilarang.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(CITY OF KUALA LUMPUR) (NO. 2) ORDER 2013

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 408 published on 14 December 2012, notice was given of the

intention to make an order under subsections 70(1) and (2) of the Road Transport Act

1987 [Act 333];

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Dato Bandar Kuala Lumpur

against the making of such order;

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 70(1) of

the Act, the Dato Bandar Kuala Lumpur, after consultation with the Director General for

Road Transport, and after taking into consideration the matters referred to in

subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use of

Road) (City of Kuala Lumpur) (No. 2) Order 2013.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 28 December 2012.

Prohibition

2. The driving of all vehicles on the part of the road as specified in column (1) of the

First Schedule, as shown on the map in the Second Schedule, otherwise than in the

directions specified in column (2) of the First Schedule, for the period specified in

column (3) of the First Schedule is prohibited.
